author: AfterWorld
name: BeriCog
short: Economy games and income built on BeriCore.
description: Casino games, work, fishing, treasure maps and income. Balances are held by the BeriCore cog, which must be loaded.
install_msg: Thanks for installing BeriCog! Install and load the BeriCore cog first, as it holds all balances.
end_user_data_statement: Stores each member's income and collection times, treasure maps, vault and fishing data per server, lottery tickets, and a global audit log containing user IDs. It does not implement Red's data deletion requests.
